when.q: When will I get my ticket?
when.a: Your e-ticket arrives by email as soon as payment is confirmed. It usually takes a few minutes.

cancel.a: You can cancel for free within 24 hours of booking. After that, the airline's rules apply. [İPTAL KOŞULLARI]

bags.q: Is baggage included in the price?
bags.a: For every flight we show whether a personal item, cabin bag and checked bag are included, with weights and sizes, on the flight card and when you choose a fare. You can add extra bags (several, or a heavier one if offered) when booking or later with “Add bags”; we also show the airline's maximum there.

transfer.q: Do I need to check in my bags again on a connecting flight?
transfer.a: Usually not for connections on the same ticket. Routes combining different airlines may require it; we clearly mention this on the flight card.

payment.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: Credit and debit cards, iDEAL, Apple Pay and Google Pay.

change.a: If your fare allows it, yes: pick a new day in the “Change flight” section of your booking page. The airline's change fee and any fare difference are shown before you confirm. Some low fares can't be changed; we say so when you choose a fare.

docs.a: Your passport or ID card must be valid for the whole trip; some countries require a few more months of validity after you return. Whether you need a visa depends on your nationality and destination; check the destination's official source before you fly.
